claim: Shadow of War's official online features (Online Conquest, Online Vendettas, social/fight-pit modes) are asynchronous; the predecessor Shadow of Mordor's online features were shut down in January 2021 while Shadow of War's were stated to remain unaffected, and no official 2025-2026 shutdown notice was found.
evidence: GameSpot: Mordor servers shut down per WB support; KitGuru: sequel online 'will remain unaffected' for now.
verification_method: Web search 2026-10-23; no WB support page for Shadow of War server status retrieved.
limitations: Current server status not verified from a WB primary source; Steam forum posts are anecdotal.
next_experiment: Co-op tests must run with online features disabled/offline; confirm how the game behaves with no WB connection on an isolated copy.
